author: @InTheAssembly
text: SpaceX has filed its S-1. Listing as $SPCX on Nasdaq targeting June 12, $1.75T valuation, $75B raise. This is the biggest IPO in history. Watch the satellite / launch comp basket: $RKLB $RDW $BKSY $LMT for sympathy moves into the roadshow.

author: @hkuppy
text: Everyone is obsessed with $SPCX. The interesting trade is the secondary read-through: who got diluted, who is the better launch comp, where does the IPO sucker capital come from? I'm looking at $RKLB and $GHM not the parent.
